GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiStyle class.

GetConditionalTableStyle.description:
Returns a set of formatting properties which will be conditionally applied to the parts of a table that match the 
requirement specified in the sType parameter.

params.description: The table part which the formatting properties must be applied to.
params.name: sType

GetName.description: Returns a name of the current style.

GetParaPr.description: Returns the paragraph properties of the current style.

GetTableCellPr.description: Returns the table cell properties of the current style.

GetTablePr.description: Returns the table properties of the current style.

returns.description: If the type of this style is not a `"table"` then it will return    `null`.

GetTableRowPr.description: Returns the table row properties of the current style.

returns.description: If the type of this style is not a `"table"` then it will return    `null`.

GetTextPr.description: Returns the text properties of the current style.

GetType.description: Returns a type of the current style.

SetBasedOn.description: Specifies the reference to the parent style which this style inherits from in the style hierarchy.

params.description: The parent style which the style inherits properties from.
params.name: oStyle

SetConditionalTableStyle.description: Sets conditional formatting properties that are applied to table parts matching the specified table style type.

SetName.description: Sets a name of the current style.

params.description: The name which will be used for the current style.
params.name: sStyleName

SetParaPr.description: Sets the paragraph properties to the current style.

params.description: The paragraph properties that will be set.
params.name: paraPr

SetTableCellPr.description: Sets the table cell properties to the current style.

params.description: The table cell properties that will be set.
params.name: tableCellPr

SetTablePr.description: Sets the table properties to the current style.

params.description: The table properties that will be set.
params.name: tablePr

SetTableRowPr.description: Sets the table row properties to the current style.

params.description: The table row properties that will be set.
params.name: tableRowPr

SetTextPr.description: Sets the text properties to the current style.

params.description: The text properties that will be set.
params.name: textPr

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiStyle object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the used numberings will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteNumberings
